title: Early quests, wintertodt and ardy cloak 1
seoTitle: OSRS Ironman Early Game Guide: Quests, Wintertodt & Ardy Cloak
description: Starting your ironman journey. Complete early quests, get 50+ firemaking at Wintertodt, and unlock the Ardougne cloak 1 for its teleport.

steps.text: Start as a female character, don't forget to make yourself an ironman before leaving tutorial island
steps.note: Female char is for Recruitment Drive quest
steps.updateNote: The female-character requirement for Recruitment Drive was removed in November 2022 - Sir Leye can now be defeated by any character while unarmed (or with certain specific weapons). Pick whichever character you like.

steps.text: Use every book and lamp on Herblore UNTIL 77 herb, after that they should be used on prayer (HCIM only), agility or RC, whichever you dislike the most
Use Authenticator AND 2-step verification on registered e-mail
As soon as you spawn, sell bronze dagger, sword, axe, wooden shield and shortbow to the general store
Buy a spade, start X marks the spot quest
Drop your runes and ask for more from the magic tutor, pick up your runes
Pick up every item spawn in the castle, including the ones in cellar, don't forget the cabbage
Fill a jug with water
Talk to the duke to start Rune mysteries quest
Go to the top of the castle, bank everything
Light the 4 logs until 15 Firemaking
After that fletch the same logs into 1000 arrow shafts
Bank at least 4 ashes
Bank 7 logs for later
Take out GP, Clue (x marks the spot), air talisman, spade, mind/air runes, bread and shrimp from the bank
Thieve men until 5 thieving
steps.note: HCIMs eat bread/shrimp, quickhop cabbages from basement if needed, normals can just suicide for hp

steps.text: Dig up the clue north of bob's axes
Buy a steel axe
steps.note: Make sure the world is full stock, should cost 200gp

steps.text: Start Restless ghost by talking to Father Aereck
Dig up the clue behind lumby castle
Kill a rat (safespot with wind strike) for its meat
Hug the fence and run west, make sure you always have at least 15 energy to get gap just incase you get attacked by anything
Pick up 5 swamp tar around the swamp cave entrance
Talk to Father Urhney to get the ghostspeak amulet, equip it
Take the air talisman to wizard tower
Run to draynor village
Dig the next clue for X marks the spot
Pick up 2 cheese at Aggie in Draynor village
Buy 5 wine from Fortunato, use as emergency food if needed
Dig up the casket at draynor pig pen
Finish the X marks the spot quest by talking to Veos
steps.note: Don't use the xp lamp on anything yet

steps.text: Walk to rimmington, pick up 1 snape grass near crafting guild at the hobgoblins
steps.note: Make sure you have ~10 run energy for this so you can just quickly grab one and get out

steps.text: Walk to Falador
Start The Knight's sword quest by talking to the squire
Minigame tele to Clan wars
Pick up 2 iron bars just northwest of Ferox
Recharge run energy using the pool of refreshment, then use the green portal to teleport to Castle wars
Walk to yanille, buy a pie dish at Yanille cooking shop
Walk to port Khazard, buy 1 swamp paste from the general store
Do Monk's friend
Get 35 woodcutting at oak trees and firemake the logs as you cut them

links.text: 2 Oaks just south of ardy zoo

steps.text: Get 20 thieving with cake
steps.note: Bank 15 bread and ALL the normal cakes you get, drop chocolates

steps.text: Steal silk until 25 thieving
Do Sheep herder
Take out GP, swamp paste and small fishing net
Do Sea slug, fish shrimp while doing quest for diary
steps.note: Don't drop quest reward oyster pearls, worth over 500gp in the general store

steps.text: After the quest, buy however many sardine you can fit in your inventory from the fish shop in Witchaven
Sell your silk for 60gp each, keep 10 in bank for quests
You should have 10k GP at this point. Buy a Player-owned house
Use the xp lamp from X marks the spot on Construction
Buy 2 ropes, 5 vials, 30 balls of wool and 7 papyrus from ardy general store
Dig up clue hunter gloves and boots north of Ardy
Buy greenman's ale from Rasolo
Do Dwarf cannon until the part where you have to go to Ice mountain
Pick up 130 planks north of the Barb agility course
Do BA tutorial for minigame tele
steps.note: You can skip the tutorial nowadays but just make sure you have the teleport unlocked (attempt to minigame tele to BA)

steps.text: Start Barcrawl miniquest
Do Waterfall quest until the part where you have to go to the gnome maze, remember to read the book
Walk to Gnome stronghold
Buy a drink from Blurberry for the Barcrawl miniquest
Buy these items from Heckel Funch (east of Blurberry): 1 pineapple, 1 orange, 2 lemons, 1 cocktail shaker, 1 cocktail glass, 1 Dwellberries, 1 bucket of milk, 1 chocolate dust
Buy 1000 bronze arrowheads (100/world for 1gp ea)
steps.note: The weapon shop is on 3rd floor south of the ladder. Shops restock gradually over time, so hop worlds to buy your full amount - ironmen have had separate shop stock from mains since 2014

steps.text: Make the hangover cure for plague city quest
Walk to Ardy with rope, dwellberries, hangover cure
Do Plague city
Home tele to lumby and run north to Varrock east bank
steps.note: Equip ghostspeak amulet if you've banked it at some point

steps.text: Complete Daddy's home miniquest
Sell the 8 bolts of cloth from the quest reward back to the sawmill
From sawmill buy 500 bronze nails
Minigame teleport to Clan wars, recharge energy and use the portal to Castle wars
Take steel axe and a tinderbox
Run south-west of castle wars, cut and firemake teak logs until 50 Firemaking
Home tele, Lumby
Talk to the ghost for Restless ghost quest
Run to Draynor bank
Buy a chronicle and 2 teleport cards from Diango
While at Diango, buy a Rainbow scarf (120gp) as a warm-clothing item for Wintertodt
steps.note: Counts as warm clothing for Wintertodt (pair it with the Clue Hunter boots/gloves you dug up earlier). Optional: speak to Gilbert in the flower field SE of Barbarian Village to also unlock the free Rainbow jumper (claimed from Diango) - but you don't pass Barb Village until after Wintertodt, so the scarf alone is the practical pickup here.

steps.text: Use the housetab and train construction with your planks, make bookcases until out of planks
steps.note: Use phials to un-note planks

steps.text: Walk to port sarim, buy 1000 feathers from the fishing store
steps.note: Should just about have enough money, but if you can't afford all of them then it's not a big deal, point is to just get a few fletching levels before WT

steps.text: While at Port Sarim, complete the Pandemonium quest (start with Will & Anne on the docks) to unlock the Sailing skill
steps.note: Zero requirements; grants 300 Sailing XP. You're already at Port Sarim here so it's a free pickup. Sailing isn't on the main critical path - see the optional Sailing Track for the rest of the questline and training.

steps.text: Take the boat to Great Kourend
Make your way to Wintertodt
steps.note: Fletch all 1k bronze arrows while you walk. If you see wolves near wintertodt, you went the wrong way. Shouldn't get hit by anything on the way

steps.text: Should now have 15 fletching and 20 construction as well, this will increase the xp you get in these skills from wintertodt
Do Wintertodt until 200k cash, get at least 22 fletching at wintertodt as well
steps.note: UPDATE (Oct 2024): The Warmth Meter system has replaced HP-based damage entirely. A 10 HP player and a 99 HP player now take identical warmth damage, so there is no longer any advantage to rushing Wintertodt at low HP. Wear 4 warm clothing items for optimal warmth (Clue Hunter boots/gloves + the Rainbow scarf from Diango in Draynor; Gilbert near Barbarian Village unlocks a free Rainbow jumper). Rejuvenation potions now restore 30% Warmth per dose so no external food is needed. Supply crates have been replaced by a Reward Cart with a Big-search option. Bruma Herbs no longer grant Farming XP. Do whatever method you want; solo, mass, fletching the logs. If you want, feel free to get 99 firemaking in one go
steps.updateNote: The Warmth Meter (Oct 2024) removed the 10HP rushing advantage entirely. There is no longer any urgency to do Wintertodt before training HP. Focus on getting warm clothing (4 pieces) rather than low HP.

steps.text: Home tele, Lumby
items: ALL of your mind and air runes

steps.text: Drop runes and get more from mage tutor
Buy 3 buckets and 1 bucket pack from the general store
Walk north to Fred's farm
Kill a chicken with wind strike for it's meat at Fred's farm
Pick up egg north of Fred
Kill 1 cow calf for meat
Fill 3 buckets with milk
steps.note: Dairy cow is north of the windmill

steps.text: Walk to Barbarian village (you can walk east of draynor manor by the river, don't walk around through falador or something like that)
Get ammo mould and the notes for Dwarf cannon (Ice mountain northwest of Barb village)
Use chronicle tele
Start Gertrude's cat, pick up doogle leaves, use the leaves on a sardine
Continue gertrude's cat, talk to the kids at Varrock centre
Talk to Romeo to start Romeo and Juliet quest
Start Demon slayer, get the 2 keys in Varrock
Talk to Reldo for the Knight's sword quest
Do Shield of Arrav on any visit to Varrock
Buy a fire staff
Buy a newspaper from Benny
Buy gloves and pink skirt from clothes shop
Buy a rotten tomato from the crate near the achievement diary guy
Get a drink for barcrawl at the bar south of Varrock fountain
Buy 4 beers from the same bar
Do museum for 9 Hunter and Slayer
Steal tea from the tea stall
Give the package to Aubury, talk to him again for the notes
Buy 100 fire runes, 300 earth and water, 4000 mind, 8000 airs
Walk to the pub north-east of Varrock
Get a drink for the barcrawl
Cut a dying tree at the sawmill and make 1 regular plank for diary tasks
Continue Gertrude's cat at lumberyard
Varrock east bank
Fill 1 inventory of buckets with water, bank them
Pick cadava berries and 16 redberries
Mine 4 copper ore and 1 iron ore
Chronicle tele
Finish Gertrude's cat, raise it with the sardine you bought
Talk to juliet
Varrock west bank
Walk to Barbarian Village via Edgeville, buy bronze med helm
Pick up 1 cooked meat from the table and burn it on the fire in the bar
Safespot barbarians in the bar for 13 magic
steps.note: You can skip getting 13 mage here if you know how to safespot the first 2 forms of witch's house boss

steps.text: Use the trees to safespot a bear for its meat south of mind altar
Get a drink from the Falador bar for Barcrawl
Buy 5 wizard mind bombs from the bar
Buy 8 woad leaves, offer 20gp to get 2 leaves
Bank
Do Witch's house
steps.note: Tank the first 2 phases on the north side of the shed and run to safespot when you need to eat. It's possible to safespot the first 2, but with fire strike you are in no real danger of dying with cakes

steps.text: Do Druidic ritual
Buy 1 PACK of eyes of newt and pestle and mortar in Taverly
Minigame tele to Clan wars
House tab to Rimmington
Complete witch's potion, onion is just north of the town
Run to port sarim
Make redberry pie
steps.note: You can buy flour and redberries at port sarim food shop

steps.text: Get a security book from the Security guard upstairs in port sarim jail for a diary task
Give the pie to Thurgo, and ask about Knight's sword
Go down the dungeon and mine 2 blurite ore, 1 is for falador diary
Use the falador teletab, talk to the squire and get the portrait from sir Vyvin's room
Use house tab and run back to thurgo for the sword, run back to Falador
Finish the Knight's sword quest
Complete Sleeping Giants quest (15 Smithing required, you have 29)
steps.note: Short quest that unlocks Giants' Foundry - a much better Smithing training method than superheating iron. Save your metal bars for Foundry rather than traditional smithing.

steps.text: Home tele and go to al-kharid
Buy 50 thread, 3 needles and all of the moulds from the crafting shop
Start prince ali rescue and talk to Osman
Fish anchovies (small fish net) south of the Al-Kharid bank for a diary
Buy 1 inv of bronze bars for questing from shantay pass
Do the tourist trap
steps.note: PUT BOTH XP REWARDS ON AGILITY, HOLD SPACE SO YOU DON'T ACCIDENTALLY PUT ONE ON THIEVING

steps.text: Minigame tele to fish trawler
Cook whatever low level raw food you got from wintertodt for 15 cooking on the fire
Buy 10 buckets of slime
Buy 10 flour from general store
Buy buckets of sand and soda ash
steps.note: You only need to buy around 600 buckets of sand and 600 soda ash, rest of crafting will be done with other methods

steps.text: Mine 15 clay south of Khazard
Fire strike imps west of the tower of life for all 4 beads
Do Fight arena
Do Tree gnome village, get Glarial's pebble on the way for Waterfall
steps.note: Safespot the khazard warlord, plenty of videos on youtube showing how to if you don't know

steps.text: Use the spirit tree and go to battlefield of khazard
Run to ZMI bank and safespot the zamorak warrior until you get a rune scimitar
steps.note: Getting the scim is optional but it's not too rare and you're still getting mage xp. You can also buy a rune sword from champion's guild if you don't want to camp for the scimitar

steps.text: Get a drink from Ardy bar for the barcrawl
Buy 4 compost pack from the Ardy farming shop
Train 42 magic at Moss giants near fishing guild
steps.note: Bury the bones

steps.text: Do Hazeel cult
Get a drink for the barcrawl quest from brimhaven bar
Do Tribal totem
steps.note: Buy some swordfish and karambwans from the food shop where you start the quest at for some of the more difficult quests

steps.text: Finish dwarf cannon
Drop runes outside glarial's tomb, get amulet and the urn
Finish waterfall
Minigame tele to fish trawler
Charter to port sarim
Go to Zeah and get 100 compost and saltpetre
steps.note: UPDATE: The Kourend favour system was completely removed in January 2024. All content previously gated behind favour is now freely accessible through skill levels, quests, or diary tasks. No need to earn any favour

steps.text: While in the Kourend/Zeah region, complete Children of the Sun to unlock Varlamore
steps.note: No requirements. Unlocks Varlamore, home to a lot of ironman content used later: Mastering Mixology (Herblore), Vale Totems (Fletching), Calcified Rocks (Mining/Prayer), and the Varlamore questline (Twilight's Promise, Perilous Moons).

steps.text: Train 42 thieving at the fruit stall in a house east of the hosidius marketplace, NOT the stall at the marketplace itself
steps.note: No favour required anymore. Use strange fruits for energy restoration, they won't last long but you can do a few quests with them

steps.text: Home tele, Lumby
Do cook's assistant
Start RFD and watch the cutscene to unlock the bank chest
Make 5 soft clay
Buy 7 buckets of milk
Do sheep shearer
Pickpocket HAM members for a rusty sword
steps.note: If you get them, keep robes, opal and buttons

steps.text: Pick up 12 onion at Fred's farm
Make 4 red, 4 blue, 5 yellow dye
steps.note: You can just use the ingredient on Aggie to skip all of the dialogue

steps.text: Get the key imprint, wig and skin paste for Prince ali rescue
Do 1 lap of the agility course for a diary
Start Vampire slayer, get 3 garlic upstairs from the cupboard
Buy birdhouse seeds from Olivia, get as many as you can be bothered for now, if worlds are bought out then try later
Buy 20 teleports for chronicle
Finish Imp catcher
items: 20 bones (kill goblins south of the draynor jail)

steps.text: Finish Rune mysteries
steps.note: Teleport to Essence mines for a diary task

steps.text: Get the Ghost's skull in the basement
Kill 5 chicken/wizards, give 25 bones for demon slayer key
Chronicle tele
Continue Romeo & Juliet, get cadava potion
Buy iron chainbody from Horvik
Walk north from Varrock to the Wilderness (level 4-7) and talk to the Mage of Zamorak to start the Abyss miniquest
steps.note: Requires Rune Mysteries to be completed. Head to the south edge of the Wilderness near the River Lum

steps.text: Return to Varrock, talk to the Mage of Zamorak at the Chaos Temple to get the scrying orb, then visit Aubury's rune shop to use the ess mine teleport (scrying orb 1/3)
Finish demon slayer
Get the stake for vampire slayer from the blue moon inn
Finish romeo and juliet
Spirit tree to gnome stronghold
Use Brimstails to go to ess mines (scrying orb 2/3, make sure you have it with you)
Start Grand tree
Clan wars minigame tele, recharge energy and go to castle wars
Get a drink for barcrawl from Yanille pub
Buy 2 bird snares, 2 butterfly jars and a butterfly net from the hunter shop
Go to Hazelmere and continue the grand tree until you are at Karamja shipyard
From Karamja shipyard, charter to Karamja, Musa point
Take boat to Port Sarim
Get a drink from the port sarim bar for barcrawl
Start Pirate's treasure
Boat back to Karamja
Fish shrimp north of banana trees for diary
Get a drink for barcrawl from the bar south of the Karamja banana trees
Do Karamja and port sarim parts of the Pirate's treasure quest
Chronicle tele
Get pirate's message from Blue moon inn, you can drop it AFTER reading the message
Spirit tree to Gnome stronghold
Finish The Grand tree
steps.note: This should get you 43 mage, if you didn't get 43 then fire strike some gnome guards

steps.text: Buy a premade blurb' sp, 4 vodka, pineapple chunks
Equip Gas mask
Spirit tree to ardy
Start biohazard, get the plague sample and 3 potions
Take the boat from Ardy docks to Rimmington
Get the touch paper from chemist and give the 3 potions to the guys outside
Take the boat back to Ardy
Visit Ardy ess mines, scrying orb 3/3
steps.note: If you didn't bank any breads when getting 25 thieving then buy 15 now from the cake stall owner. If you somehow didn't get any iron ore from wintertodt then mine 2 east of Ardy

steps.text: Use mind bomb and camelot tele
Start Merlin's crystal and talk to Gawain and Lancelot
Buy candle, 2 fishing rods, lobster pot
Buy 15 pineapples from charters
Put pineapples into the compost bin
Buy 1 pack of normal compost and all farming tools, store everything in leprechaun
Start Fishing contest
Kill Mordred and get bat bones/black candle for Merlin's crystal
steps.note: Talk to Sherlock and pick 5 flax for diaries

steps.text: Do Murder mystery
Get a drink from Seers' bar for the barcrawl
Finish Fishing contest
Go under the mountain and speak to Lady of the lake in Taverly
Do Doric's quest
Finish Pirate's Treasure
Make 5 molten glass
Do Black knight's fortress
Do Recruitment drive
Run south to Port sarim
Trade Sarah's farming shop for a falador diary task
Buy a black wizards hat from Betty at port sarim magic store
Port Sarim jewellery store, give the bread to the beggar to get the excalibur
Minigame tele to clan wars, recharge energy and go to castle wars
Hop worlds for super antipoison(1), decant them until you have like 6 full pots
Do the Observatory quest
HOME TELE, Lumby
Finish The Restless ghost
Start the Lost tribe, do until you need to go to Varrock
steps.updateNote: Goblin Diplomacy is now required before starting The Lost Tribe. Skip this step and steps 256/279 — instead, complete Goblin Diplomacy at step 278 first, then do The Lost Tribe entirely afterward (Lumbridge → Varrock → Goblin Village → Lumbridge). The extra travel is unavoidable but the guide is otherwise unaffected.

steps.text: Teleport to Varrock
Continue Lost tribe until you need to go to the goblin village
Buy priest robes (keep these after quest), boots, gloves
Finish abyss miniquest
Train Runecraft to 10, then complete Temple of the Eye quest to unlock Guardians of the Rift
steps.note: GOTR is a massive improvement for RC training on ironmen. The quest gives ~5k Runecraft XP on completion (~9k including in-quest XP). GOTR provides runes, talismans, and the Raiments of the Eye set for bonus runes. This makes RC no longer need to be your lowest skill for Tears of Guthix.

steps.text: Get the magic words for Merlin's crystal at the altar
Continue Biohazard
Do the Digsite quest
Chronicle tele and start Dragon slayer at champion's guild
Use the G.E spirit tree and go to battlefield of khazard
Finish Biohazard
Finish off Ardy easy tasks, and get the cloak
steps.note: Use lamp on agility. Not worth holding on to it, we won't be 30herb for a long time still and 2.5k xp isn't that much anyway

steps.text: Trade cat for 200 death runes
Chronicle tele and buy a new kitten
Cloak tele back to Ardy
Do Jungle potion
steps.note: Bring a small fish net with u and fish ~100 karambwanji for your kittens, BE CAREFUL of aggressive NPCs

steps.text: Do Shilo village
steps.note: HCIM; Buy a few karambwans and swordfish from brimhaven food store

steps.text: Teleport to Camelot
Finish Merlin's crystal
Start Holy grail and talk to Merlin
Get boots of lightness
steps.note: Play the Church organ in the Seers' Village church for diary task

steps.text: Do Elemental workshop 1
Buy 1 inv of stew from the Seers bar
Falador teleport
Do Goblin diplomacy
Continue Lost tribe
Home tele, Lumby
Finish Lost tribe
Go through the gate to Al-Kharid
